subject.title: fix(amazon-bedrock): keep blank credentials from overriding AWS auth

question: Should default-chain Amazon Bedrock requests permanently remove whitespace-only AWS credential variables from the shared gateway process, or should the extension adopt an owner-approved non-mutating credential-resolution design?
rationale: The patch now preserves variables for bearer and skip-auth modes, but default-chain requests still mutate process-global environment state; choosing whether that is an acceptable compatibility contract requires Bedrock ownership intent.

options.title: Approve scoped cleanup
options.body: Accept deletion of whitespace-only AWS credential variables only on Bedrock default-chain paths, because those values otherwise block AWS profile, SSO, ECS, or IMDS fallback.

options.title: Require non-mutating resolution
options.body: Ask for a Bedrock-local credential-resolution approach that bypasses blank values without changing process.env for other in-process consumers.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped cleanup
recommendation.body: Accept deletion of whitespace-only AWS credential variables only on Bedrock default-chain paths, because those values otherwise block AWS profile, SSO, ECS, or IMDS fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: They can clarify the intended implementation and evidence, while a current-main Bedrock history owner should make the final compatibility choice.
